doc:
# Hyperscaling Violation — Non Relativistic

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “hyperscaling violating geometry”).

claims.name: infrared_theory_dual_hyperscalingviolating_lifshitzlike
claims.statement: The infrared theory is dual to a hyperscaling-violating Lifshitz-like geometry with dynamical exponent $z = 5$ and hyperscaling-violating exponent $\theta = 1$.

sources.title: Three-dimensional super Yang-Mills with compressible quark matter

claims.name: hyperscalingviolating_geometry_arises_special_case
claims.statement: A hyperscaling-violating geometry arises in a special case after dimensional reduction.

sources.title: Asymptotically AdS spacetimes with a timelike Kasner singularity

claims.name: asymptotic_geometry_hyperscalingviolating_conformal_ads
claims.statement: The asymptotic geometry is hyperscaling-violating and conformal to AdS$_2$ × H$^2$.

sources.title: Supersymmetric black holes and attractors in gauged supergravity with hypermultiplets

claims.name: smarrlike_entanglement_relation_demonstrated_hyperscaling
claims.statement: The Smarr-like entanglement relation is demonstrated in a hyperscaling violating geometry background.

sources.title: Generalized entanglement temperature and entanglement Smarr relation

claims.name: analysis_focuses_exclusively_unstable_modes
claims.statement: The analysis focuses exclusively on unstable modes arising from the hyperscaling-violating portion of the geometry.

sources.title: Criteria For Superfluid Instabilities of Geometries with Hyperscaling Violation

claims.name: hyperscaling_violating_geometry_conjectured_sign
claims.statement: In hyperscaling violating geometry, the conjectured sign property is disproved for $n>3$ with general configurations.

sources.title: Holographic n-partite Information in Hyperscaling Violating Geometry

claims.name: holographic_calculation_hyperscalingviolating_bulk_geometry
claims.statement: A holographic calculation in a hyperscaling-violating bulk geometry yields the same leading term for the entanglement entropy if the effective dimension of the hyperscaling-violating theory matches the spectral dimension of the fractal.

claims.name: groundstate_geometry_has_hyperscalingviolating_geometry
claims.statement: The ground-state geometry has a hyperscaling-violating geometry in the IR and is asymptotically anti–de Sitter in the UV.

claims.name: ground_state_emd_model_represented
claims.statement: The ground state of the EMD model is represented in the bulk via a hyperscaling-violating geometry.

claims.name: holographic_dc_conductivity_dimensional_systems
claims.statement: The holographic DC conductivity of $(2+1)$-dimensional systems is analyzed in a bulk hyperscaling violating geometry.

sources.title: DC conductivity with external magnetic field in hyperscaling violating geometry

claims.name: hyperscaling_violating_geometry_conjectured_sign_
claims.statement: In hyperscaling violating geometry, the conjectured sign property is confirmed for strips of equal length with equal separation distance.

sources.title: Holographic n-partite Information in Hyperscaling Violating Geometry

claims.name: hyperscaling_violating_geometry_lattice_structure
claims.statement: In hyperscaling violating geometry with lattice structure, the ratio $\eta/s$ obeys a temperature power law $\eta/s \sim T^{\kappa}$.

sources.title: Holographic Shear Viscosity in Hyperscaling Violating Theories without Translational Invariance

claims.name: behavior_thermal_entropy_function_temperature
claims.statement: The behavior of the thermal entropy as a function of temperature is compared between the fractal geometry and the hyperscaling-violating background.

claims.name: mixedstate_complexity_probed_through_mutual
claims.statement: Mixed-state complexity is probed through the mutual complexity for the BTZ black hole and the hyperscaling violating geometry using the holographic subregion complexity conjecture.

sources.title: Holographic study of entanglement and complexity for mixed states

claims.name: case_theta_associated_violation_area
claims.statement: The case $\theta=2$ is associated with a violation of the area law of entanglement entropy in the regime of validity of the hyperscaling violating geometry.

sources.title: On the IR completion of geometries with hyperscaling violation

claims.name: other_words_even_though_dealing
claims.statement: In other words, even though we are dealing with a hyperscaling violating geometry, nontrivial behaviors of the resultant entanglement entropy are the same as that of a Lifshitz geometry in $d+1$ dimensions.

sources.title: Thermalization in backgrounds with hyperscaling violating factor

claims.name: renormalization_group_flows_interpolate_between
claims.statement: The renormalization group flows interpolate between AdS$_4$ in the UV and a hyperscaling violating Lifshitz geometry in the IR with $1<z<3$ and $\theta=z+1$.

sources.title: Holographic Hall conductivities from dyonic backgrounds

claims.name: turning_point_rho_rho_not
claims.statement: The turning point $\rho_0 (l,\rho_c)$ is not solvable globally in either exact or perturbative form from hyperscaling violating bulk geometry with a finite radial cutoff.

sources.title: Quantum entanglement measures from Hyperscaling violating geometries with finite radial cut off at general d, $θ$ from the emergent global symmetry
